title: Error Rate Calculation
text: Compute bit error rate or symbol error rate of input data, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Selected samples from frame} sets Sample indices; {Receive delay} sets the received signal delay, {Computation delay}, {Computation mode} sets the samples to consider, {Output data}, {Variable name} sets the output data variable, {Reset port} sets the option to add Rst input port, {Stop simulation} sets the option to stop simulation after specified number of errors, {Target number of errors} sets the option to stop simulation after specified number and {Maximum number of symbols} sets the option to stop simulation after comparing specified number of symbols. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Sel
ports.summary: Sample indices positive integer | column vector of positive integers

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Difference between transmitted and received data column vector

params.name: Computation mode
params.values: Samples to consider Entire frame (default) | Select samples from mask | Select samples from port

params.name: Selected samples from frame
params.values: Sample indices [] (default) | positive integer | column vector of positive integers

params.name: Variable name
params.values: Output data variable name ErrorVec (default) | character vector | string scalar

params.name: Reset port
params.values: Option to add Rst input port off (default) | on

params.name: Stop simulation
params.values: Option to stop simulation after specified number of errors or comparisons off (default) | on

params.name: Target number of errors
params.values: Option to stop simulation after specified number of errors 100 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Maximum number of symbols
params.values: Option to stop simulation after comparing specified number of symbols 1e6 (default) | positive integer
